limitations: Only the first row of each Q4_K matrix was inspected, not every model weight.
FP16 scale/bias storage rounds parameters; float32 formula equality is an arithmetic representation check, not clinical or bitwise engine equivalence.
CPU reference uses float32 affine arithmetic; Metal float16 arithmetic, accumulation and output decoding are not qualified.
Q6_K and a complete model conversion are not implemented by this helper.
